items.raw_excerpt: LEEDS, England, Aug 21 : England captain Joe Root expressed his disappointment on Friday that Headingley will not stage an Ashes test next year after leading his country to a crushing victory over Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs at his home ground.England have won their last seven tests in Leeds, includin
items.summary_en: England cricket captain Joe Root said he is disappointed. Headingley, his home ground in Leeds, will not host an Ashes test next year. England had just won against Pakistan by a big margin at the same ground.
items.summary_ko: 잉글랜드 크리켓 주장 조 루트가 아쉬운 마음을 드러냈습니다. 리즈에 있는 그의 고향 구장 헤딩리는 내년 애시스 시리즈 경기를 개최하지 못하게 되었습니다. 잉글랜드는 바로 같은 구장에서 파키스탄을 상대로 큰 차이로 승리한 직후였습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Alberta's technology minister faced yet another firing line of fury at the government's second town hall hearing from residents over its plan for artificial intelligence data centres.

items.raw_excerpt: A new development program aims to break decades-old myths and shift the perspective
items.summary_en: The Argentine Tennis Association has a new program to find young players. The program wants to break old ideas that have lasted for decades. It hopes to change how people think about building tennis stars.

items.raw_excerpt: A dupla brasileira se classificou com vitória por 2 sets a 0 sobre os sobre italianos Simone Bolelli e Andrea Vavassori, atuais campeões do Masters de Miami e Roma. Os adversários na semi, a partir das 13h30 deste sábado (23), serão o monegasco Hugo Nys e o o francês Edouard Roger-Vasselin.
items.summary_en: Rafael Matos and Orlando Luz beat Italian players Bolelli and Vavassori in two sets. The Brazilian pair now plays in the doubles semi-final at the ATP event in Cincinnati on Saturday.
